title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #1

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which element is called Prithvi? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Earth
   C. Fire
   D. Air

2. A family keeps a Tulsi plant at home. What is a good daily habit for them? (1 mark)
   A. Burn it
   B. Cut it down
   C. Ignore it
   D. Water it every morning

3. Where does the River Ganga begin? (1 mark)
   A. In the Himalaya mountains
   B. In Lake Victoria
   C. At the Indian Ocean coast
   D. In the Rift Valley

4. In a maize farm, what does the sun's heat that ripens the crop represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Jal
   B. Prithvi
   C. Akash
   D. Agni

5. What do all four Enlightened Beings in the lesson teach in common? (1 mark)
   A. Selfishness
   B. Kindness, truth and service
   C. Anger
   D. Pride

6. Narsimha is an Avtar of which god? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Vishnu
   B. Lord Buddha
   C. Lord Shiva
   D. Lord Ganesh

7. From where did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A boat
   B. A river
   C. The sky at noon
   D. A pillar in the palace

8. What does Aparigraha mean? (1 mark)
   A. Take everything
   B. Talk a lot
   C. Do not be greedy or hold too many things
   D. Always be angry

9. How would you practise Ahimsa at school? (1 mark)
   A. By hurting insects
   B. By breaking things
   C. By not bullying and by caring for animals
   D. By teasing the smaller children

10. Which is a main message of Jain scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Practise Ahimsa
   B. Be greedy
   C. Practise pride
   D. Take revenge

11. What does Ik Onkar stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Six directions
   B. Many rivers
   C. Two gods
   D. There is one God

12. Which action follows the Jain teaching of gentleness? (1 mark)
   A. Throwing stones
   B. Breaking eggs
   C. Chasing animals
   D. Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun

13. Which is a bad habit during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing or talking
   B. Folding hands
   C. Listening
   D. Sitting still

14. What does Vandana mean? (1 mark)
   A. A tree
   B. A river
   C. A meal
   D. An act of respect and prayer

15. What is a prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A way of talking to God
   B. A kind of meal
   C. A sport
   D. A map

16. What did King Harishchandra give up rather than break his promise? (1 mark)
   A. His shoes
   B. His kingdom
   C. His lamp
   D. His horse

17. What should you do if you find an item left on the vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Throw it away
   B. Give it to the driver or conductor
   C. Give it away
   D. Keep it

18. What is a skit? (1 mark)
   A. A game with rules
   B. A dance only
   C. A map
   D. A short act showing a story

19. Amina pays Ksh 200 for sugar costing Ksh 150 and is given Ksh 100 change. How much extra did she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 200
   B. Ksh 150
   C. Ksh 50
   D. Ksh 100

20. Which is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Doing your own homework
   B. Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   C. Owning up to a mistake
   D. Returning a lost item

21. In the Shibi story, what did the hawk want? (1 mark)
   A. The dove as food
   B. Water
   C. A house
   D. A crown

22. How should we treat others who hold different beliefs about death? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Listen with respect
   C. Laugh
   D. Argue

23. What does Dharma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A river
   C. A sport
   D. The right way of living

24. Which is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   B. Praying
   C. Being honest
   D. Being kind to animals

25. What is done to the Shiva Linga on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. It is covered
   B. It is bathed with water and milk
   C. It is painted red
   D. It is thrown in a river

26. Which teaching of Paryushan do children practise when they forgive a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Pride
   C. Revenge
   D. Forgiveness

27. Which planet is closest to the Sun? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Venus
   C. Mars
   D. Mercury

28. Which is the first month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Phalguna
   B. Magha
   C. Kartika
   D. Chaitra

29. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Magha
   B. Phalguna
   C. Ashadha
   D. Chaitra

30. Shukra is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mercury
   B. Venus
   C. Saturn
   D. Mars

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how a maize farm uses all five elements. (4 marks)

32. Explain how you would present a short skit on one Enlightened Being. (4 marks)

33. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

34. What does yoga mean? (2 marks)

35. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

36. Which day is Shanivaar and which planet is it linked with? (2 marks)

37. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)

38. State three ways of showing respect to the National flag and Anthem. (3 marks)

39. Describe Bharat's action after he returned to Ayodhya. (3 marks)

40. What do the words Param and atma mean? (2 marks)

41. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

42. Match four scriptures with their faiths. (4 marks)

43. List four facts about the planets linked with the days. (4 marks)

44. Name the three prayers studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

45. Explain how the four faiths in this lesson teach integrity. (5 marks)

46. Write the Indian names for Tuesday and Wednesday. (2 marks)

47. Give the date and origin of International Yoga Day. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Earth
   Prithvi is the Sanskrit word for earth, the soil and rocks.

2. D — Water it every morning
   Watering the Tulsi is part of caring for it.

3. A — In the Himalaya mountains
   The Ganga starts high in the Himalaya and flows across northern India.

4. D — Agni
   Heat and light belong to Agni.

5. B — Kindness, truth and service
   Their teachings are alike in these values.

6. A — Lord Vishnu
   Narsimha is one of Lord Vishnu's Avtars.

7. D — A pillar in the palace
   The pillar broke open and he appeared.

8. C — Do not be greedy or hold too many things
   Aparigraha is non-greed.

9. C — By not bullying and by caring for animals
   Ahimsa means not harming others.

10. A — Practise Ahimsa
   Ahimsa is central in Jainism.

11. D — There is one God
   Ik Onkar means One God.

12. D — Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   Gentleness to living things is central.

13. A — Laughing or talking
   We should be quiet and respectful.

14. D — An act of respect and prayer
   Vandana is respectful prayer.

15. A — A way of talking to God
   We thank God and ask for wisdom.

16. B — His kingdom
   He gave up his whole kingdom.

17. B — Give it to the driver or conductor
   Returning it shows integrity.

18. D — A short act showing a story
   Skits help us learn lessons.

19. C — Ksh 50
   Correct change is 50, so 100 minus 50 is 50 extra.

20. B — Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   Copying and claiming it is cheating.

21. A — The dove as food
   The hawk demanded the dove.

22. B — Listen with respect
   Respect for others is a value.

23. D — The right way of living
   Dharma includes duty, honesty and kindness.

24. A — Thinking Dharma is only for grown-ups
   Children can practise Dharma too.

25. B — It is bathed with water and milk
   This is called abhishek.

26. D — Forgiveness
   Paryushan teaches saying sorry and forgiving.

27. D — Mercury
   Mercury is nearest to the Sun.

28. D — Chaitra
   Chaitra comes first and Phalguna last.

29. B — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

30. B — Venus
   Shukra is Venus.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: The soil is Prithvi, rain and river water are Jal, the sun's heat is Agni, the wind that carries pollen is Vayu, and the open sky is Akash.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each element linked correctly to the farm, up to 4.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a story, decide the characters, practise the lines, act it out, and then say what lesson it teaches.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the story, roles, practice, acting and lesson (any four).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: To join or unite the body, breath and mind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for join, 1 mark for the three things.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Saturday, linked with Saturn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stand straight, be quiet, never let the flag touch the ground, learn and sing the anthem (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused the throne, went to ask Ram to return, took Ram's sandals and placed them on the throne, and ruled as a humble servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Param means highest and atma means soul.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ramayan: Hinduism. Kalpasutra: Jainism. Dhammapada: Buddhism. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji: Sikhism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mercury is closest to the Sun; Mars is the red planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn has rings (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Gayatri Mantra, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva and Saraswati Vandana (any correct pair earns 1 mark).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark each, rounded up.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hinduism: truth (Harishchandra). Sikhism: honest earnings (Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo). Jainism: not stealing (Asteya). Buddhism: right speech and not stealing or lying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each faith and 1 mark for a summary.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tuesday: Mangalvaar. Wednesday: Budhvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 21 June, chosen by the United Nations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 mark for the United Nations.
